text.text: Filling the northern half of the room is a huge aquarium.
There is a blue label here.

!! FROBOZZ MAGIC BALLOON COMPANY !!

Hello, Aviator!

To land your balloon, say LAND
Otherwise, you're on your own!

No warranty expressed or implied.
On the ground is a small, worn piece of paper.

The paper is barely readable. You can only make out "... valuables are completely safe ... advanced magic technology ... impossible to take valuables from the depository ... either teller's ... Many customers faint ... teller pops in ... seems to walk through ... walls ..."
A long wooden club lies on the ground near the diamond-shaped window. The club is curiously burned at the thick end.
The words "Babe Flathead" are burned into the wood.
200 neatly stacked zorkmid bills are here.
On the floor sit 200 neatly stacked zorkmid bills.
Each bill is worth 100 zorkmids, and bears the legend "In Frobs We Trust".
Worn and battered in one corner of the room is a blue book.
This book is written in a tongue with which I am unfamiliar.
There is a square brick here which feels like clay.
Shards of a smashed trophy case litter the room.
There is a wooden bucket here, 3 feet in diameter and 3 feet high.
There is a solid steel cage in the middle of the room.
There is a package of candied goodies here.
There is a card with writing on it here.

Warning:
    This room was constructed over very weak rock strata. Detonation of explosives in this room is strictly prohibited!
         Frobozz Magic Cave Company
         per M. Agrippa, foreman
There is a vicious-looking dog guarding the entrance. It is more or less your usual dog, except that it has three heads and is the size of an elephant.
A rotten old wooden chest is in one corner among the debris.
There is an engraved zorkmid here.
On the floor is a priceless gold zorkmid (a valuable collector's item).
This is a beautiful octagonal coin bearing the legends "Ten Thousand Zorkmids" and "In Frobs We Trust".
A gigantic dog collar, large enough for three rhinoceros-sized dogs, is lying amidst the debris.
Lord Dimwit's crown is here.
The excessively gaudy crown of Lord Dimwit Flathead sits in the safe.
"Here lie the Flatheads, whose heads were placed on poles by the Keeper of the Dungeon for amazing untastefulness."
There is a balloon here, broken into pieces.
A huge dead dragon is lying half blocking the stream.
There is a dead sea serpent in a heap here.
The text is in some obscure tongue. All that can be made out is a reference to "sending in a matchbook cover."
A huge red dragon is lying on the rocks here, watching.
A huge red dragon is lying here, blocking the entrance to a tunnel leading north. Smoke curls from his nostrils and out between his teeth.
The icing spells out "Eat Me."
The room is cluttered with debris from an explosion. The walls seem ready to collapse.

desc.text: stoppered glass flask filled with liquid

text.text: A stoppered glass flask with a skull-and-crossbones marking is here. The flask is filled with some clear liquid.
There is a skull-and-crossbones engraved on the glass.
There is a coil of black, braided string here.
There is a demon floating in midair here.
There is a nervous Volcano Gnome here.
There is a Gnome of Zurich here.
A handsome book, bound in green leather, sits in the center of the room.
This book is written in a tongue with which I am unfamiliar.
There is a small hook attached to the rock here.
There is a small hook attached to the rock here.
A mass of ice fills the western half of the room.
There is a dented steel box here.
A strangely familiar brass lantern is lying on the ground.
F
F
There is a mangled steel cage here.
There is a matchbook saying "Visit ZORK I" here.

">> Visit Exotic ZORK I <<

Consult the Frobozz Magic Travel Agency, or visit your local computer store for more details."

** U.S. News and Dungeon Report **

FAMED ADVENTURER TO EXPLORE GREAT UNDERGROUND EMPIRE

Our correspondents report that a world-famous and battle-hardened adventurer has been seen in the vicinity of the Great Underground Empire. Local grues have been reported sharpening their (slavering) fangs....

"Zork II: The Wizard of Frobozz" was written by Dave Lebling and Marc Blank, and is (c) Copyright 1981, 1982, 1983 by Infocom, Inc.
There is a beautiful red crystal sphere here.
In the center of the table sits a blue crystal sphere.
There is a clear crystal sphere lying in the sand.
There is a strange black sphere here.
There is a pearl necklace here with hundreds of large pearls.
The leak has submerged the depressed area in a pool of tears. There is a hazy something at the deepest part of the pool.
The portrait of J. Pierpont Flathead is here.
A portrait of J. Pierpont Flathead hangs on the wall.
A beautiful young woman, wearing a dirty and bedraggled gown, sits on a rock in the corner. Her hair is unkempt and she is oblivious to your presence, almost in a trance.
Lying in the dust, and covered with mold, is a purple book.

This book is written in a tongue with which I am unfamiliar. Assuming that one can indeed tell a book by its cover, it is likely filled with purple prose, the like of which is rarely seen outside the Great Underground Empire.
A spray can is in the corner. In large type is the legend "Frobozz Magic Grue Repellent".

!!! FROBOZZ MAGIC GRUE REPELLENT !!!

Instructions for use: Apply liberally to creature to be protected. Duration of effect is unpredictable. Use only in place of death!

(No warranty expressed or implied)
There is a robot here.
There is a green piece of paper here.

!!  FROBOZZ MAGIC ROBOT COMPANY  !!

 Hello, Master!

   I am a late-model robot, trained at GUE Tech to perform various simple household functions.

   To activate me, say the following:

        >ROBOT, <things to do>

At your service!
There is a moby ruby lying here.
On the floor lies a moby ruby.
There is some water here.
There is a baby sea serpent swimming in the aquarium.
There is a Flathead stamp here.
This three zorkmid stamp bears a portrait of Lord Dimwit Flathead, "Our Excessive Leader".
Nestled in the chest is a wrought gold statuette of a dragon.
An Elvish sword of great antiquity is here.
A sword of Elvish workmanship is on the ground.
There is a beautiful unicorn here cropping grass.
There is a Stradivarius here.
A hand-lettered label is affixed to the wall.

Warning!

The exhibits in this room are the property of the mighty Wizard of Frobozz (me), and are the fruits of diligent labor and study over many years. He who touches anything will regret it.

(signed)
Frobozz
There is some water here.
Right beside the purple book sits a white one.

It is written in an unfamiliar tongue and details the use of various magical objects, chiefly the so-called "magic wand". Apparently these devices work by pointing them at the object to be ensorcelled, and then chanting the appropriate magic words. (It's truly amazing how credulous these ancients were, isn't it?)
The Wizard of Frobozz is here, eyeing you warily.
Imbedded in the wall is an ornate trophy cabinet.
